g01-new-bag.observed_description: One spotless bright-green school backpack with a crisp full shape, straight seams, shiny silver zippers and a clean green top handle stands upright alone in the middle of a light wooden table in front of a plain pale wall, facing the camera. No stain, patch, label or other object.
g01-new-bag.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop (declared four_card false): reads as a clean new bag down to 180 px.

g03-same-books.observed_description: Two closed hardcover books with identical plain bright-red cloth covers and the same height, width and thickness stand upright side by side on a worn light wooden table in front of a plain pale wall, covers facing the camera with a gap between them. No title, mark or other object.
g03-same-books.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the two books read as the same down to 180 px.

g05-big-table.observed_description: In a bright empty room with a pale wooden floor and a plain white wall a huge long heavy wooden dining table with thick legs spans almost the whole photo width, its top empty; one light-oak slatted dining chair stands in front of its left end, facing right, and the table is about five times as wide as the chair. A wall corner is at the right edge; no people, plates, rug or other furniture.
g05-big-table.note: Usable in 3:2 only (declared four_card false): the table reads as very big against the chair down to 180 px; the centered 4:5 crop cuts both ends of the table.

g02-used-bag.observed_description: The same backpack, table and wall as the new-bag photo; the green fabric is faded to a pale dull green with dark dirt stains and scuffs, the bottom edge is frayed with loose threads, the front pocket has a square brown patch, the zipper pulls are knotted strings and the bag sags slightly. It is closed and whole; no labels or other objects.
g02-used-bag.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop (declared four_card false): faded color, stains and patch read as a used bag down to 180 px.

g04-different-books.observed_description: On the same worn wooden table and pale wall the left plain bright-red hardcover book is unchanged; on the right stands a plain dark-blue hardcover book that is clearly shorter, about three quarters of the red book's height, and a little wider. Both covers are plain with no title or mark; nothing else on the table.
g04-different-books.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): a tall red book and a shorter dark-blue book read as different at a glance down to 180 px. The blue book is less short and less thick than the prompt asked.

g06-small-table.observed_description: The same bright empty room and light-oak slatted chair as the big-table photo, with the big table gone; beside the chair stands one small square wooden side table with four thin legs and an empty top, about as high as the chair's seat and narrower than the chair. A bright window opening is at the right edge; no people or other objects.
g06-small-table.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop (declared four_card false): one small table beside the chair reads at 180 px. Its top is level with the chair's seat rather than lower, so alone it could pass for a stool; the card's sentence and the big-table pair carry the meaning.
